_comment: The recorded shape of main's live required-status-check contexts, for the
required-contexts class in policy_lint.mjs (#957). The linter fetches the
branch endpoint AND the ruleset objects (bypass-aware; the branch endpoint
alone is not) and reddens on any name the live set and this shape disagree
on, so the next ruleset change reddens the tree within one push. When it
reddens: re-record THIS file by hand from the API, never by copying the
linter's message, and re-read every assertion site against the new list.
An unreachable or rate-limited API must NOT redden this class (policy-docs
is itself a required context; a transient outage must not block every
merge), which is why a failed fetch is a printed skip, never a finding.
